start: Member of a gym whose colour is dark navy; a workout started on the phone

steps.action: Look at the watch's rest timer
user_sees: The ring and words in a lighter blue that is easy to read on black
must_not: Navy that cannot be read on black
MettleUp orange for a gym member

user_sees: "Rest is over" fills the round screen with that blue, black words on it
The "Rest is over" card tinted the same blue
must_not: White words on a light colour
The corners of a round watch painted

start: A member with no gym (or an older phone app that sends no colour)
The gym's colour arrives broken ("red", "#FFF" or empty)

must_not: A black ring on the black screen

start: The member leaves the gym, or joins another gym

steps.action: Open the watch app before the next workout
user_sees: The last colour the phone sent (kept after the workout)
Orange without a gym, or the new gym's colour
must_not: The old gym's colour after the first workout item arrives
